article_title: Flight chaos caused by millisecond software defect, says air traffic control body

tasks.prompt: What does the Nats report identify as the cause of the September air traffic disruption?
options: A software defect that produced corrupted data in a millisecond
A nationwide airport workers' strike
A deliberate shutdown ordered by airlines
A shortage of aircraft fuel
tasks.correct_answer: A software defect that produced corrupted data in a millisecond
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הדו״ח של Nats מייחס את השיבוש לפגם תוכנה שהפיק נתונים פגומים.

tasks.prompt: Why were restrictions placed on UK air traffic after the defect?
options: To avoid paying airline compensation
Controllers had reduced information and needed to maintain safety
All airport runways had closed for repairs
Passengers requested fewer flights
tasks.correct_answer: Controllers had reduced information and needed to maintain safety
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפקחים היה פחות מידע זמין, ולכן הוטלו הגבלות כדי לשמור על בטיחות.

tasks.prompt: What does “resilience” mean when airlines demand improvements to the Nats system?
options: A promise of cheaper tickets
The number of available aircraft
The system's ability to withstand and recover from failures
A legal exemption from paying compensation
tasks.correct_answer: The system's ability to withstand and recover from failures
tasks.explanation_hebrew: חוסן המערכת הוא יכולתה לעמוד בתקלות ולהתאושש מהן.

tasks.prompt: In the regulator's compensation decision, what are “extraordinary circumstances”?
options: Routine changes to a flight timetable
A passenger's preference for a different airport
Airlines' standard meal arrangements
An exceptional event that can affect compensation entitlement
tasks.correct_answer: An exceptional event that can affect compensation entitlement
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המונח מתאר נסיבות חריגות המשפיעות על הזכאות לפיצוי, לפי החלטת הרגולטור.

tasks.prompt: When were the restrictions on UK airspace lifted?
options: At 7:30pm on 8 September
Immediately at 10:00am
At 12:30pm before the defect became serious
Three days before the incident
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הגבלות המרחב האווירי הוסרו ב־19:30, אף שהשיבושים נמשכו לאחר מכן.

tasks.prompt: What does Airlines UK mean when saying airlines “picked up the pieces - and the tab”?
options: They physically repaired the Nats software
They dealt with disruption and bore associated costs
They collected unused flight tickets
They paid for air traffic controllers' salaries
tasks.correct_answer: They dealt with disruption and bore associated costs
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הביטוי מתאר טיפול בתוצאות התקלה ונשיאה בהוצאות שנגרמו.

tasks.prompt: Describe the timeline between the defect and the lifting of restrictions.
expected_points: Its seriousness was not apparent for another two and a half hours
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין את סדר האירועים וזמניהם בלי לבלבל בין תחילת התקלה לזיהוי חומרתה.

tasks.prompt: Why did delays continue after the airspace restrictions ended?
expected_points: Aircraft and crews were left out of place
More than 2,000 flights had been cancelled
Restoring the network takes longer than lifting an immediate restriction
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר את השפעת השרשרת התפעולית, לא לטעון שההגבלות נשארו בתוקף.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the software failure, safety response and different reactions to the Nats report.
expected_points: A software defect corrupted data and limited controller information
Restrictions were imposed to preserve safety
Thousands of flights were cancelled or disrupted
Nats apologised and said safety was not compromised
Government launched a review and airlines demanded compensation
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לסכם באנגלית גורם, השפעה ותגובות, תוך ייחוס אמירת הבטיחות ל־Nats.

tasks.prompt: Use Addie Kitson's experience to explain why passengers may disagree with the compensation rules.
expected_points: Her return flight from China diverted to Stockholm
She waited 19 hours in the airport
She incurred nearly £100 in extra costs
She received only an £11 food voucher
The regulator viewed the event as extraordinary circumstances, limiting compensation
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכתוב הסבר באנגלית שמבחין בין סיוע, עלויות וזכאות לפיצוי; אין להבטיח פיצוי.
